title: Governed GitHub Pages Deployment Authority and Portfolio Synthesis — Publication Audit
stated_consumer_purpose: X0 and later release/distribution milestones can expose real Publish/Portfolio workflows in the desktop product, backed by authorization and verifiable deployment status rather than preview-only artifacts.
summary: Lane X3 builds the publication deployment authority that S3/T1/T1.1/T1.2 preview lanes intentionally deferred. Created GitHubPagesDeploymentService, DeploymentEvidenceLedger, PortfolioSynthesisService, deployment models, 4 new schemas, and 29 tests. All existing 96 publication tests continue to pass. Ruff, pyright, and schema validation clean. Live external acceptance remains a named deferred milestone.

GitHubPagesDeploymentService.description: Governed GitHub Pages deployment application service. Consumes approved ProjectPageCompilerResult output + authorization receipt, executes Pages configuration and content deployment, and produces durable deployment evidence. Never deploys without explicit authorization. Never deploys unapproved or safety-failed content.

PortfolioSynthesisService.description: Aggregates approved project-page publication projections into a deterministic portfolio publication projection. Only approved, safety-passed, content-light-complying project records are included.

models_created.DeploymentOutcomeReceipt: Terminal evidence receipt for deployment outcome (success/refusal/failure). Schema: rig.relay.publication_deployment_evidence.v1
models_created.DeploymentPreparationResult: Deployment readiness inspection result before any external mutation. Schema: rig.relay.publication_deployment_preparation.v1
models_created.DeploymentRecoveryState: Recovery state for deployment operations needing retry/reconcile
models_created.DeploymentRefusalCode: Structured refusal reasons for publication deployment (18 codes)
models_created.DeploymentStatus: Status of a deployment operation (10 states: preparing through recovery_required)
models_created.PortfolioProjectionRejection: A project record rejected from portfolio synthesis with reason
models_created.PortfolioSynthesisInput: Input for portfolio synthesis from approved project records
models_created.PortfolioSynthesisResult: Result of portfolio synthesis with projection, HTML, and evidence

schemas_created.description: GitHub Pages deployment execution request and authorization binding schema
Terminal deployment outcome evidence receipt schema
Portfolio synthesis input and result schema

approval_and_authorization.pattern: Lane A/Lane B remote action authorization
approval_and_authorization.gate: Deployment refuses without valid authorization receipt. Authorization is consumed atomically before any HTTP request.
approval_and_authorization.receipt_gating: Existing Lane A receipt infrastructure (remote_action_authorization.py, _authorization_consumer.py) is consumed through well-defined public APIs — no new authorization infrastructure was created.

evidence_and_idempotency.pattern: Same fcntl locking, operation-id dedup, conflict detection as PublicationEvidenceLedger
evidence_and_idempotency.idempotency: Same operation_id + same receipt evidence_digest → returns existing event_digest; same operation_id + different content → RuntimeError('idempotency conflict')
evidence_and_idempotency.retry: compute_recovery_state() returns typed recovery action (retry, reauthorize, verify_only, abandon) based on prior deployment state
evidence_and_idempotency.duplicate_safety: New deployment action requires new operation_id; retry with consumed authorization receipt returns AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED

external_api_boundary.design: GitHubPagesDeploymentService consumes optional GitHubPagesAdapter for real API calls
external_api_boundary.adapter_absent: Returns `deferred_external_acceptance` status with URL — application-service boundary is production-shaped even without live credentials
external_api_boundary.api_verified: GitHub Pages API endpoints were researched from official docs at https://docs.github.com/en/rest/pages/pages?apiVersion=2022-11-28
external_api_boundary.permissions_known: Pages:write for deployments, Pages:write + Administration:write for site configuration
